lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr₆Ge₂ (reduced formula Cr₃Ge) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Cr, 6 Ge) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ge centers have 9 neighbors (6 Cr, 3 Ge) over distances of about 2.33–2.81 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Cr and Ge polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing among Cr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
